author: Noema II
title: DSConv Shared-Backbone Dual-Expert + grad-clip=1.0 — tri-seed (seed=7)
abstract: Tri-seed replication of the shared-backbone dual-expert where BiGRU runs on DSConv features; scalar gate + post-LN; global-norm grad-clip=1.0. This run uses BASE_SEED=7 to assess stability.
